meta.title: One graph owns the work
meta.description: A native macOS control room for coding agents. Build a workflow on a canvas, run it against a project, and watch Claude Code and Codex work in parallel.

hero.description: RigOne is a native control room for coding agents. Define an agent once, place it on a canvas, connect the steps, and run the graph against a project on your Mac.
hero.note: Apple Silicon · macOS 13+ · signed and notarized · AGPL-3.0

features.title: What it does
features.description: Claude Code and Codex as first-class peers, on one canvas.

canvas.title: Visual workflows
canvas.description: Agent steps, local commands, checks, checkpoints, loops, conditional paths and retries — saved as a graph you run again.

parallel.title: Real parallel execution
parallel.description: Independent branches overlap in time instead of taking turns behind a single worker. Order comes from the graph, never from the engine.

watch.title: A run screen you can read
watch.description: The plan on the left, what every agent said on the right, and the question that stopped the run pinned where you will answer it.

agents.title: Reusable agents
agents.description: Vendor, model, reasoning depth, timeout, file access, tools, connections and skills — chosen once per role and reused everywhere.

context.title: Project-scoped knowledge
context.description: Curate instructions and notes on disk, then see which context a run actually used.

evidence.title: Evidence that outlives the terminal
evidence.description: Run receipts, attachments, handoffs, death proofs and a diagnostic bundle stay available after the output is gone.

how.title: How it works
how.description: Three steps, and the third one is the only one that spends money.

write.title: Write an agent
write.description: One job, one instruction. Pick the vendor, the model and what it is allowed to touch.

arrange.title: Put agents in a row
arrange.description: That row is a workflow. Branches that do not depend on each other run at the same time.

run.title: Run it and watch
run.description: Point the graph at a folder on this Mac. Answer when an agent asks; everything else keeps going.

honest.title: Built to fail honestly
honest.description: RigOne treats orchestration failures as product failures, not terminal noise.

scopes.title: Overlapping write scopes
scopes.description: are refused before the first process starts.

cancel.title: Cancellation
cancel.description: terminates the whole process group and then proves it is dead.

secrets.title: Prompts and secrets
secrets.description: go through stdin, never command-line arguments, and child environments are rebuilt from an explicit allowlist.

green.title: A green exit code
green.description: without proof that tests ran is not accepted as a green check.

cta.title: Put your agents on one canvas
cta.description: Free and open source. The build is signed with Apple Developer ID, notarized and stapled.
